Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Lovvorn
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 143 as introduced will increase the obligations of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, the Alabama Association of Emergency Managers and the Association of County Commissions of Alabama, by an undetermined amount, to develop uniform guidelines regarding safer place facilities (for use during severe weather events) that meet the provisions of this bill by December 31, 2021.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Lovvorn
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/04/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 143 as passed the House of Representatives will increase the obligations of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, the Alabama Association of Emergency Managers and the Association of County Commissions of Alabama, by an undetermined amount, to develop uniform guidelines regarding safer place facilities (for use during severe weather events) that meet the provisions of this bill by December 31, 2021.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
